name: CLI-Anything
description: Making ALL Software Agent-Native - converts existing software tools to be usable by AI agents through CLI interfaces. Enables any tool to work with AI coding agents.

name: agentmemory
description: #1 Persistent memory for AI coding agents based on real-world benchmarks - enables agents to remember context across sessions and workspaces, solving one of the biggest pain points in AI coding workflows.

name: CtrlOps
description: Deploy, Debug & Manage Linux Servers with AI - terminal-based AI assistant for server operations and DevOps management.

name: AIPS
description: A Claude Code plugin to stop re-doing AI setup every project - provides persistent project configuration and skills management, eliminating repetitive AI agent setup overhead.

name: ShioriCode
description: Open-source alternative to Codex & Claude Code - CLI-based AI coding assistant with repo-aware capabilities and multi-language support.

name: Haystack
description: AI-powered PR review tool - reviews the pull requests that actually need human attention by filtering noise and focusing on important changes, saving developer time.

name: Drizz
description: Mobile tests that write, run, and fix themselves - autonomous mobile testing AI that creates, executes, and repairs test cases, bringing AI automation to mobile QA.

name: AgentRail
description: A local control plane for AI coding agents - provides routing, supervising, and auditing multi-agent work across repos and CI. Helps teams track which agent is doing what and which changes are ready for review.

name: Prave
description: The missing management layer for AI Agent Skills - enables authoring once and deploying skills across Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Cline, and Amp with telemetry and audit. Includes MCP integration for Claude Desktop.

name: Cplt
description: macOS Seatbelt sandbox wrapper for AI coding agents - runs agents inside Apple's kernel-level sandbox to prevent unauthorized access to credentials, secrets, and sensitive files, addressing AI agent security concerns.

name: codegraph
description: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode - fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local code understanding. Optimizes AI coding agent performance.

name: Polygram
description: AI-native design and coding app to build mobile & web apps - combines planning, design, code generation, live preview, and GitHub sync in one workflow.

name: Pixcode
description: A self-hosted control room for AI coding agents - enables orchestration and controlled execution of agents across development workflows.

name: oh-my-pi
description: AI Coding agent for the terminal - hash-anchored edits, optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, subagents support.
